hypothesis.root_cause: The string URL resolver constructs URLs before removing ASCII C0 characters from its owned inputs.
hypothesis.expected_violation: an interior ASCII C0 character remains in the resolved owned path text

build_script:
mkdir -p /work/.corsair-java/classes /work/.corsair-java/lib /work/.corsair-java/empty
curl -fsSL -o /work/.corsair-java/lib/jsr305-3.0.2.jar https://repo.maven.apache.org/maven2/com/google/code/findbugs/jsr305/3.0.2/jsr305-3.0.2.jar
echo "766ad2a0783f2687962c8ad74ceecc38a28b9f72a2d085ee438b7813e928d0c7  /work/.corsair-java/lib/jsr305-3.0.2.jar" | sha256sum -c -
javac --release 8 -encoding UTF-8 -g -sourcepath /work/.corsair-java/empty -cp /work/.corsair-java/lib/jsr305-3.0.2.jar -d /work/.corsair-java/classes /work/src/main/java/org/jsoup/helper/Validate.java /work/src/main/java/org/jsoup/helper/ValidationException.java /work/src/main/java/org/jsoup/internal/StringUtil.java
